movie.title: Cena di classe
movie.overview: A group of former high school classmates reunite after seventeen years for the funeral of an old friend. Aided by alcohol and a forgotten video, they sneak into their old school one night to relive the magic of that time. But a simple reunion quickly turns into a criminal adventure.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Seventeen years after graduating, a group of former high school friends reunites for a funeral, only to find themselves embroiled in a wild criminal adventure after breaking into their old school.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Brought together by the tragic loss of an old friend, a group of former high school classmates meets again after seventeen years apart. Fuelled by alcohol and nostalgia from a long-lost video, they decide to sneak into their old school late one night to relive their youth. However, what was meant to be an innocent walk down memory lane rapidly spirals out of control into an unexpected criminal mess. They must navigate both old emotional baggage and new, high-stakes trouble as their simple reunion turns chaotic.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Seventeen years after going their separate ways, a group of former high school classmates comes back together under somber circumstances for the funeral of an old friend. Overcome with grief and nostalgia, the group gathers for a dinner that quickly becomes fueled by heavy drinking and shared memories. When a forgotten video from their school days resurfaces, it rekindles the longing to experience the magic and carefree nature of their youth once more. In a fit of spontaneous nostalgia, the intoxicated group decides to break into their old high school in the middle of the night. Walking through the dark hallways, long-buried secrets, lingering grudges, and unresolved romances quickly begin to bubble to the surface. What starts as a sentimental trek down memory lane takes a dark and unexpected turn when their antics trigger a cascade of unintended events. As the night progresses, their innocent trespass devolves into a desperate criminal adventure, entangling them in serious trouble with the law. Forced to lean on one another just as they did in their teenage years, the group must figure out how to extricate themselves from the mess they created. By morning, their impulsive nocturnal escapade forever alters their adult lives and reframes their past relationships.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Seventeen years after graduation, a group of former high school friends is brought back together by the funeral of an old classmate. What begins as a bittersweet reunion filled with alcohol, reminiscing, and a nostalgic trip down memory lane via a long-forgotten video soon takes an unpredictable turn. Seeking to reclaim the magic of their youth, the group impulsively sneaks into their old high school late at night. However, old emotional wounds resurface alongside unexpected chaos, transforming a sentimental gathering into a high-stakes, wild adventure that tests the bonds of their long-standing friendship.
